notes: Overview: Synchroware builds an in-product help + insights assistant for their B2B SaaS dashboard. Mid-market, 450 employees, US HQ.
Discovery & initial trial: Started with Hosted API in Jan 2026 (free credits). Ran chat flows + embeddings for search. Demo 2026-02-10 with Ava + Diego.

POC summary: 2-week POC (Feb 9-23). Workloads: interactive chat (avg 350 tokens per session), semantic search indexing (batch embeddings), and reranking for search results. Observed peak qps ~18 RPS during simulated demo traffic; 95th pct latency with hosted API ~120ms for generation. Cost sensitivity noted: target cost < $0.007/token equivalent and want clearer per-token/unit economics for embeddings.

Decision path: Product + infra + security + procurement. Product leads want Dedicated for predictable latency and lower unit cost. Infra wants VPC/private control for compliance. Security requires SOC2 + SSO/SAML + KMS + retention controls.

Dedicated ask (initial proposal): 12-month committed pool. Baseline commit = 1,000 GPU-hours/month (NVIDIA T4 equivalent for quantized models) + 2.5x burst capacity for monthly demo windows and embedding runs. Overage policy proposed: bill overage at committed rate * 1.4 (negotiating down to 1.2). Ramp schedule requested: 500 GPU-hrs month 1, 800 month 2, 1000 months 3-12 with quarterly review.

Pricing conversation notes: Synchroware pushed for a blended ARR discount if they commit 12 months + Prepay option. They prefer a predictable spend profile; asked for a guaranteed max monthly overage cap for first 3 months while tuning batching/caching.

Technical requirements: Model footprint preference = 13B-70B family (quantized), need autoscaling behavior to preserve 99th pct latency SLO under burst, KV/prefix caching for chat sessions, and routing fallback to smaller model (13B) for degraded capacity.

Security & compliance steps: Completed initial security questionnaire (attached), inbound VPC peering request filed, KMS integration scoped, legal requested data residency clause (US only) and audit_log retention 12 months.
Quotes from calls: 'We need a cost ceiling for month 1 while we tune batching' — Head of Engineering. 'If dedicated gets us consistent latency under 150ms, we'll expedite procurement' — VP Product.
Open items: exact overage multiplier, burst window sizing, SLA/penalty language for latency breaches, agreed ramp schedule in SOW, network diagram for VPC peering, finance to sign off on ARR commit.
Timeline to date: Hosted API trial -> demo -> 2-week POC -> Dedicated pricing request -> draft SOW in progress.

Internal notes for AE/SE: emphasize Optimize recommendations after onboarding to lower effective cost via batching + prefix caching; propose a 3-month 'safety' overage cap to get procurement comfortable.
Buyer stakeholders: VP Product (decision), Head of Eng (technical signoff), Director of Security (security signoff), Procurement Manager (procurement/legal).
Risk: Procurement may push back on annual prepay; security wants proof of KMS integration before go-live.
